detail.longDescription: I made a simple macOS utility that operates like come of the agent monitoring tools used with the elgato Stream Deck. I recently got one for the first time and have loved the UX of monitoring my agents this way but wanted something that was little more portable and not tethered to my home office. This utility is more or less just a simple UX around passively monitoring agents and wanted to share for anyone this resonates with. Cheers
